evidence.title: Microsoft Vaasa update reports pre-construction work began in mid-July
evidence.excerpt: The July 13 update reports pre-construction work already began on the Vaasa datacenter plot in mid-July. Its August 12 section still describes building-permit applications. The page directly links the contractor's Tuotantotie 15 project.
